name: Organized Study
summary: Consistent topics across study, Memory Maki, and progress.

features.title: Clearer study topics
features.text: All 6,000 questions now use consistent topic names across study, Memory Maki, and progress.

features.title: Questions in the right subject
features.text: Reassigned questions appear under their appropriate subjects. Your saved answers, bookmarks, and history stay available.

features.title: Controlled question editing
features.text: Choose from a controlled topic list and maintain structured references for each question version.

name: Focused Study
summary: Focused study, clear Fresh Catch completion, and mobile controls that stay within reach.

features.title: Finish your Fresh Catch
features.text: The final question now shows Finish catch. Unanswered items are easy to revisit, and completion confirms your score and saved stamp.

features.title: Focused Memory Maki
features.text: Answer, view the result, and rate recall with five thumb-friendly buttons. Open explanations, references, and notes when needed.

features.title: Three-step deck setup
features.text: Choose subjects, topics, and card count. Advanced ranges and exact question selection remain available.

features.title: Made for mobile
features.text: Compact navigation and persistent study controls keep the question and next action within reach.

features.title: A simpler Counter
features.text: Fresh Catch and Memory Maki lead the page. Find other study tools in More and your collection in Passport.

features.title: Progress filters
features.text: Set filters in one sheet, then apply them together. Daily stamps and subject coverage open on demand.

features.title: Menus on short screens
features.text: The account menu scrolls within the screen, including phone landscape, so every action stays reachable.

name: Counter Notes
summary: A dated changelog, complete Memory Maki progress, and fixes for study recovery, Bento recipes, and reminders.

features.title: Release history
features.text: Read previous release notes without leaving the update window.

features.title: What's New
features.text: Updates now use concise entries grouped under Added, Improved, and Fixed. Each release shows its version and date.

features.title: Resume from the latest saved answer
features.text: Reloading after a save conflict now refreshes the question, timer, and session status in practice rounds and Memory Maki.

features.title: Memory Maki progress
features.text: Submitted answers now appear in coverage, accuracy, and Missed questions, including past answers. Filter My Progress by Memory Maki to see them.

features.title: Bento question swaps
features.text: Replacing a question respects your full recipe, including Any topic and All difficulties, while keeping the other questions in place.

features.title: Fresh Catch reminder timing
features.text: An old snooze no longer sends the next dayâ€™s reminder before your chosen time.

features.title: Head Chef reminders
features.text: Administrators can receive Fresh Catch reminders when enabled, just like learners.

features.title: Cohort activity alerts
features.text: Pending invitations, archived accounts, and disabled learners are excluded from cohort activity alerts and focused practice assignments.

name: Welcome Roll
summary: Your seat at the Counter, a guided look around the kitchen, and more ways to make each study session count.

features.title: Your seat is at the Counter
features.text: Everyone starts at the Counter after signing in, including Head Chef. Your daily catch and Memory Maki deck are ready there.

features.title: Take the Sushi Bar Hop
features.text: Follow an illustrated tour with real app screenshots, clear steps, and links to every study tool. Tap a screenshot for a closer look.

features.title: Your Fresh Catch, your mix
features.text: Choose how many of your daily ten are unseen or previously missed, and spread them across your subjects.

features.title: One last tasting
features.text: Reach 80% rated 5 in Memory Maki to unlock a short recall check with answers at the finish.

features.title: Every Memory Maki answer counts
features.text: Answering a new card advances your completion tier immediately. Memory Maki also earns weekly study points under the same repeat-counting rules as other modes.

features.title: Build a precise bento
features.text: Set topic and difficulty quotas, review the actual questions, and load class recipes shared by Head Chef.

features.title: Meet the next sushi crew
features.text: Five new named tiers and unlockable portraits continue your journey from 5,200 to 6,000 completed questions.

features.title: A clearer Chefâ€™s Review
features.text: Track matching stems, missing references, and version-specific answer checks.

features.title: Welcome a whole cohort
features.text: Preview a CSV roster and create individual invitation links for new learners.

features.title: Head Chef can join the round
features.text: Your administrator account can study and earn a place on the leaderboard.
